item.title: Fukui Food Guide: Echizen Crabs, Oroshi Soba & Sauce Katsu-don
item.description: Fukui Prefecture does not have a particularly famous culinary reputation among overseas visitors, which makes arriving and eating well here one of the more pleasant surprises available anywhere in Japan. The prefecture runs from the Sea of Japan’s frigid, productive waters in the north to the buckwheat-growing valleys of the Echizen highlands in the interior, and its food culture draws unselfconsciously on both. The crab is world-class, the soba is deeply serious, and even the pork cutlet has been adapted into something distinctively local.
